source_refs.note: Exercise 3.5, Question 8: Property III with given integral values; book p. 102. Key on p. 300 under 'Exercise 3.2'.

blocks.explanation:
Is sawal mein \(f\) ka formula nahi, sirf do integrals ki values di hain.
Diya kya hai? \([0, 3]\) par integral 20 aur \([0, 10]\) par 45.
Find kya karna hai? \([3, 10]\) par integral.
Rule kaunsa? Property III: \([0, 10]\) do hisson \([0, 3]\) aur \([3, 10]\) se mil kar bana hai. Jaise poori roti ke do tukre hon: poori roti mein se ek tukra hata dein to doosra tukra bach jata hai.
Plan: interval torna, values rakhna, minus.
steps:
Diya gaya: \(\int_{0}^{3} f(x)\,dx = 20\), \(\int_{0}^{10} f(x)\,dx = 45\).
Maloom karna: \(\int_{3}^{10} f(x)\,dx\).
Tareeqa: Property III \(\int_a^b f = \int_a^c f + \int_c^b f\), jahan \(a = 0\), \(c = 3\), \(b = 10\).

\([0, 10]\) ko 3 par torein
\[\int_{0}^{10} f(x)\,dx = \int_{0}^{3} f(x)\,dx + \int_{3}^{10} f(x)\,dx\]
Kyun: Property III, kyunke 3 interval ke andar hai (\(0 < 3 < 10\)).

Values rakhein
\[45 = 20 + \int_{3}^{10} f(x)\,dx\]
\[\int_{3}^{10} f(x)\,dx = 45 - 20 = 25\]
Kyun: dono taraf se 20 minus kiya; unknown integral akela reh gaya.
Dhyan dein: \(\int_3^{10}\) ko \(45 + 20\) samajhna ghalat hai; chhota hissa poore mein se minus hota hai.

Tasdeeq
\[20 + 25 = 45 \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: dono tukre jor kar poora wapas aa gaya. Answer key mein bhi 25 hai.
